Visit note | 2025-07-31 03:00 PM | Dr. Sharmin Akter, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Priya Paul, 27, female. Mrs. Paul returns for review regarding her ongoing symptoms of weight gain, extra hair on the face, and irregular periods. She works as a fisherman and noticed the weight gain after starting a desk job in Wari. She has a history of Bronchial asthma, which is currently stable. She reports no severe pelvic pain or unexpected bleeding. Examination reveals: BMI 32.0, BP 111/76 mmHg, pulse 76 bpm, weight 46 kg. Systemic examination is unremarkable. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. Advice given: aim for 5% weight loss, exercise 150 minutes a week, and reduce sugary drinks. Follow-up in 3 months.

Visit note | 2025-07-31 03:30 PM | Dr. Arif Hossain, Pulmonology | Patient: Liton Mollah, 79, male. Mr. Mollah returns for a review of his breathing difficulties, reporting that his breathlessness has been worse for several days alongside a long history of smoking. He is a homemaker and mentioned the symptoms flared after rubbish was burned near his home in Rajshahi. He has a known comorbidity of Essential hypertension. He denies chest pain at rest or ankle swelling. On examination: SpO2 86%, BP 141/92 mmHg, pulse 71 bpm, weight 66 kg. Chest auscultation reveals widespread wheeze and reduced breath sounds.
